recipes.title: Create the SLO from its file

steps.say: On the SLOs page press Create SLO - an SLO is the reliability target users actually feel.
Choose the SLO definition {1} (the file written as code in the repo).
Press Validate to check the target, the SLI query and the window.
Press Save & apply to start tracking it.

recipes.verify: The SLO appears in the list with its error budget remaining.

steps.say: Open Report - it shows how much error budget is left and how fast it burns.
Read Error budget remaining and Burn rate 1h: a burn rate above 1 spends the budget faster than the window allows.

recipes.title: Generate burn-rate alert rules

steps.say: On the SLOs page press Generate alert rules - multi-window burn-rate alerts page you when the budget burns too fast.
Set Write rules to {2}, where Prometheus loads rule files from.

recipes.verify: The rules file exists in Files; check it with promtool in the console.
